background.text: Patron saints: Cesena: Saint John the Baptist, with the Madonna del Popolo as co-patron. Imola: Saint Cassian (feast 13 August). Urbino: Saint Crescentinus (feast 1 June)

Government: Nominally the Papal States; in practice a mosaic of local lordships (Malatesta, Riario, Manfredi, Montefeltro) which Cesare, son of Alexander VI, subjugated by force between 1499 and 1502, seating his new duchy at Cesena
Terrain: Hill country descending from the Apennine ridge toward the Adriatic coast, the towns strung along the Via Emilia
